description: Finds components for a need described in plain words: a keyword ('pricing', 'marquee'), a few words ('dark saas hero') or a sentence ('pricing with three plans and a yearly toggle'). Matches component names, categories, the purpose of each section and its industry and style, understands plurals and related terms (plans finds pricing, three finds trio), and returns the best 25 first, each with its category and purpose. Follow up with get_component for the source; use list_components to see a whole category.

query.description: What the component should be or do, in English, e.g. 'pricing with three plans', 'testimonial marquee', 'contact form for a clinic', or a name fragment like 'OrbitGallery'.

name: search_components
title: Search components
